arguments.question: Using only the supplied ANET Q2 2026 results/filing already in the packet, did management identify any current component, optical/interconnect, manufacturing or logistics constraint as affecting Q3 revenue or gross-margin guidance, as distinct from generic filing risk factors? If not, confirm that the commodity/input channel remains unquantified.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether commodities supplies an independent 5-/21-/63-session directional channel or only a conditional review risk.
